note: What this mod has actually been read against. .github/workflows/upstream-watch.yml diffs `verified` against each repo's latest release/tag and opens an issue when one moves. Update a `verified` only after re-checking the hooks listed in `watch`.

upstream.why: every hook we wrap, plus GameSpeed.LEVELS, Stats.isShiny, mod.save, mod.ui.push (the ListMenu screen id and its onChoose contract), mod.content.pokemon:each, mod.world:overworld/current/mapOverview (the '~' water marker), save.inventory, and -- the one internal, FISH mode only -- OverworldState:goFishing plus the player.surfing / fishing / fishPose fields the bag's own rod check reads. TextBox popping itself before running the onDone that pushes its successor is load-bearing for how a cast's boxes are recognised; re-read src/render/TextBox.lua if that moves.

the voxel mod in use: owns the world pass, has no shiny feature of its own, and does not touch Pokemon.new. Replaces DramaticShape/DramaticShapeVoxelMod, whose repo stopped resolving on 2026-08-10 (last read at v1.8.1, which did roll shinies)
